science.qualification: Photosphere color from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)), dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,661 K and log g 1.7 (u1 0.402, u2 0.269): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting. The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the power law I(mu) = mu^0.1438 that Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19 fit to the star's resolved disc (VLTI/PIONIER H band, 1.5-1.8 um; not a visible band).
